description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee language search results. It extends a base FilterParams class, allows setting and retrieving an employee number, and specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for filtering employee language search results, with support for setting employee number and default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
